items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Between Kenneth Roane- he's past master ... Dial, he's past master, he would do the funeral ... We would do the other parts with him.

ctx.x: And what happened to Bobby Brown?

Oh, Bobby, after we came back from New York, we were living in New York -- Walter and I used to commute over to Newark because they recall called it at that time Newark had quite a few places and a lot of musicians go like Kenneth Roane had a nice group over there. And Bobby Brown had a nice group over there.
So I stayed after the band. Bobby went into some business with his wife in a restaurant, and we came back to New York.
